title: Public faces
rule: People who spoke or acted on the public record in their public role. Portraits are photographs already on the public record, never generated or altered (resized; one cropped to the subject). Private individuals are not included.

people.name: Henry Brooke MP
people.role: Minister of Housing and Local Government and Minister for Welsh Affairs, 1957–1961
people.tie: His ministry held the 1958 public local inquiry into objections to the Glamorgan County Council Development Plan (Area No. 2). In a Commons written answer of 18 Nov 1958 he dealt with a question on that inquiry.

people.name: George Thomas MP
people.role: Member of Parliament for Cardiff West (later Speaker of the House of Commons)
people.tie: Asked about Cardiff planning records in a written question (18 Nov 1958) and took part in the Commons exchanges on Western Ground Rents Ltd in January and February 1963. The 1963 texts do not mention Llandough or the farm.

image.source_file: File:George Thomas (Lord Tonypandy) and his mother (1460789).jpg
image.period: period photograph (10 March 1955); cropped to him alone from a photograph with his mother

people.name: Sir Keith Joseph MP
people.role: Minister of Housing and Local Government and Minister for Welsh Affairs, 1962–1964
people.tie: Hansard records that a Western Ground Rents Ltd director sent correspondence to the Minister on 3 Dec 1962, and that the Minister met the company's chairman and general manager. He answered in the Commons in early 1963. The texts do not mention Llandough or the farm.

image.source_file: File:Sir Keith Joseph visits Llangefni and Caernarfon (1469270) Crop.jpg

people.name: James Callaghan MP
people.role: Member of Parliament for Cardiff South East (later Prime Minister)
people.tie: Took part in the 1963 Commons exchanges on Western Ground Rents Ltd and Cardiff leaseholds. The texts do not mention Llandough or the farm.

people.name: Viscount Kilmuir
people.role: Lord Chancellor, 1954–1962
people.tie: Hansard (1963) records that a Western Ground Rents Ltd director sent correspondence to the Lord Chancellor on 11 July 1961.

image.source_file: File:David Maxwell Fyfe, Earl of Kilmuir, in 1951.jpg

people.name: Ted Rowlands MP
people.role: Member of Parliament for Merthyr Tydfil (later Lord Rowlands)
people.tie: Spoke in the House of Commons on 22 May 1980 about Western Ground Rents Ltd and the BP pension fund (HC Deb vol. 985).
people.image_status: no openly licensed portrait found (Parliament holds only a placeholder)

people.name: Mr Justice Hollis
people.role: Judge of the High Court (Queen's Bench Division)
people.tie: Heard BP Properties Ltd v Buckler in the High Court at Cardiff on 10 July 1986 and gave judgment on 24 July 1986, with possession suspended for six months.

people.name: Lord Justice Dillon
people.role: Lord Justice of Appeal
people.tie: Gave the leading judgment of the Court of Appeal in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2, 31 July 1987.

people.name: Lord Justice Mustill
people.role: Lord Justice of Appeal (later Lord Mustill)
people.tie: Sat with Dillon LJ in the Court of Appeal and agreed with his judgment, 31 July 1987.
people.image_status: no openly licensed portrait found (Parliament holds only a placeholder)

people.name: Sir Edward Eveleigh
people.role: Former Lord Justice of Appeal, sitting in the Court of Appeal
people.tie: Sat with Dillon LJ in the Court of Appeal and agreed with his judgment, 31 July 1987.

people.name: His Honour Judge Watkin Powell
people.role: County Court judge, Cardiff
people.tie: Gave BP Pension Trust leave to execute the 1962 possession order, with the warrant enforceable from 31 October 1974.

people.name: His Honour Judge Norman Francis
people.role: Judge, Cardiff
people.tie: Named by the Western Mail as the judge at the 5 December 1988 hearing, which declined to continue the injunction pending the application to the European Commission of Human Rights.

people.name: Alun Michael MP
people.role: Member of Parliament for Cardiff South and Penarth, 1987–2012
people.tie: The South Wales Echo of 12 May 1988 reported that he asked the Lord Chancellor to look at the case.

image.source_file: File:Official portrait of Alun Michael PCC (cropped).jpg
image.credit: Choose My PCC (Department of Levelling Up, Housing & Communities)

people.name: Lord Mackay of Clashfern
people.role: Lord Chancellor, 1987–1997
people.tie: Lord Chancellor when the local MP asked him, in May 1988, to look at the case.

image.source_file: File:Official portrait of Lord Mackay of Clashfern crop 2.jpg

people.name: Andrew Penman
people.role: Journalist (byline)
people.tie: Byline on the press report "Chainsaw farmer vows to fight on", which set out the accounts of both Mr Buckler and a BP spokesman.
people.image_status: only press-owned byline photographs found; not used

people.name: Peter Collins
people.role: Journalist, South Wales Echo
people.tie: Byline on the South Wales Echo report of 7 December 1988 and on the 1989 feature "From farm to a bus".

people.name: David Hunt MP
people.role: Secretary of State for Wales, 1990–1993 (later Lord Hunt of Wirral)
people.tie: The Secretary of State for Wales made the stopping-up order for the Old Barry Road, Llandough, published in the London Gazette of 18 March 1992 (Issue 52866, p. 4842). He held that office at the time.

image.source_file: File:Official portrait of Lord Hunt of Wirral crop 2, 2023.jpg
image.credit: ©House of Lords / photography by Roger Harris

people.name: Kanishka Narayan MP
people.role: Member of Parliament for the Vale of Glamorgan (from 2024)
people.tie: The family wrote to him on 14 November 2025; his office replied that the matter falls outside the Vale of Glamorgan constituency and pointed to the Cardiff South and Penarth MP.

people.name: Stephen Doughty MP
people.role: Member of Parliament for Cardiff South and Penarth (from 2012)
people.tie: His office forwarded HM Land Registry's letter of 18 September 2026 to the family and awaits a Ministry of Justice reply.

people.name: Iain Banfield
people.role: Chief Executive and Chief Land Registrar, HM Land Registry
people.tie: Signed HM Land Registry's letter of 18 September 2026, forwarded to the family by the local MP's office.

people.name: Cllr George Carroll
people.role: Vale of Glamorgan councillor for Llandough
people.tie: Ward councillor for Llandough; copied on the family's letter of 14 November 2025 to the MP.
